title: MI60034: Clean Coal Technology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Life cycle of coal, coal characterization, classification system of coal, rank
and grade of coal, Coal washing: Objectives and Techniques; Clean coal
technology: Definition and Objectives, Technology Options; Pre-combustion,
Combustion, Post Combustion and Conversion CCTs. Coal combustion options: FBC,
IGCC, co-generation options, Sequestration options: Capture and storage of CO2,
Coalbed Methane Recovery and utilization, Coal Gasification (In-situ and
surface Gasification), Coal to Liquid Technology.
